# Tool-generated clean controls

Built once with real PDF producers and committed; these are NOT regenerated by
`make_doc_fixtures.py` (their bytes carry timestamps). All content is synthetic.

| File | Producer | Command |
|---|---|---|
| chrome_resume.pdf | Skia/PDF m156 (the engine behind Google Docs' PDF export) | headless Chrome `--print-to-pdf` on `src/resume.html` |
| chrome_slides.pdf | Skia/PDF m156, 16:9 landscape | same, on `src/slides.html` |
| quartz_resume.pdf | macOS Quartz PDFContext (the Apple PDF stack behind Pages / Preview) | `cupsfilter -m application/pdf src/quartz_resume.txt` |

Not available on the build machine, so NOT represented here: a PDF exported from
Microsoft Word, from Apple Pages itself, or from Overleaf (no LaTeX install).
The LaTeX controls are real third-party documents fetched into the git-ignored
`.cache/external_corpus/` (see `external_real_world` in `../MANIFEST.json`).
